rv.q: Yet strangely I now find myself seized by a spirit of dumbfounded gratitude almost worthy of the converted Ebenezer himself.
This is ultimately a moving and atmospheric Christmas Carol, especially when Tiny Tim appears.
As such, it’s impossible not to leave the theatre with a festive grin and a tear in your eye.

cn.t: Jack Thorne and Matthew Warchus deliver a joyous adaptation that brings seasonal magic to the Old Vic, with critics praising its festive heart and emotional resonance in this enduringly popular tale.

vr.q: there's none better than the one at the old vic... because it's perfect
